title: Krisala Hiranandani Township Press & Digital PR Wire
description: Authoritative Press Releases, Media Kits, and Architectural Dispatches for the 105-Acre Krisala Hiranandani Integrated Township in North Hinjewadi, Pune.

items.title: Della Racecourse Pune Unveils 40-Acre Equestrian Township, 98 Private Villas & 156 Branded Residences in North Hinjewadi
items.content_html: PUNE, MAHARASHTRA — Jimmy Mistry (Della Townships India), Dr. Niranjan Hiranandani (Hiranandani Communities), and Sagar Agarwal (Krisala Developers) unveil Della Racecourse Pune inside the 105-acre Krisala Hiranandani Township Pune (Hiranandani Pune), featuring an 8-acre turf racecourse, 98 Private Luxury Villas, 5,000 sq.ft. Freehold Villa Plots (from ₹3.75 Cr*), 156 Branded Residences + 12 Sky Villas, MAYRLIFE longevity clinic, and 2–4 BHK residences from ₹79L* (Price List 2026).
items.summary: 40-acre equestrian & resort district (GDV ₹1,389 Crs / $150.1 Mn) inside 105-acre Krisala Hiranandani Township North Hinjewadi featuring 8-acre racecourse, 98 Private Villas, 156 Branded Residences + 12 Sky Villas, and 5,000 sq.ft. Villa Plots from ₹3.75 Cr*.

items.title: The Colosseum (Phase 4) Pre-Launch Window Opens at Krisala Hiranandani Township Hinjewadi
items.content_html: PUNE, INDIA — Priority allocation bookings are now open for The Colosseum Phase 4 Hinjewadi, comprising B+G+27 storey Roman neoclassical high-rises. Floor plans and cost sheets are accessible directly via Krisala Hiranandani Pricing Desk.
items.summary: Pre-launch window for The Colosseum Phase 4 featuring neoclassical towers overlooking the Sahyadri mountains and private racecourse.
